nodes.name: fx_data_historical_Decade4_2005_2014.yaml
nodes.summary: Historical USD/LKR monthly FX dataset for 2005-2014, providing lender-focused average/min/max/std rates and rolling volatility used to baseline currency assumptions in the DutchBay model.

nodes.name: fx_data_historical_Decade5_2015_2025.yaml
nodes.summary: Historical USD/LKR monthly FX dataset spanning 2015-2025, capturing the post-2022 crisis devaluation regime used to calibrate FX correction and currency risk in the project-finance model.

nodes.name: fx_data_recent_Period1_2016_2017.yaml
nodes.summary: Recent-regime USD/LKR monthly FX dataset for the 2016-2017 pre-crisis pegged baseline (~150 LKR/USD), supplying lender-focused rate and volatility series to the model.

nodes.name: fx_data_recent_Period2_2018_2019.yaml
nodes.summary: Recent-regime USD/LKR monthly FX dataset for 2018-2019, providing average/min/max/std rates and rolling volatility for the model's currency assumptions.

nodes.name: fx_data_recent_Period3_2020_2021.yaml
nodes.summary: Recent-regime USD/LKR monthly FX dataset for the 2020-2021 period, supplying rate and volatility series used in FX correction and currency risk analysis.

nodes.name: fx_data_recent_Period4_2022_2023.yaml
nodes.summary: Recent-regime USD/LKR monthly FX dataset for 2022-2023 capturing the Sri Lankan currency-crisis devaluation, used to stress-test FX assumptions in the model.

nodes.name: fx_data_recent_Period5_2024_2025.yaml
